notifications.title: Notification permission
notifications.body: Ebadat needs permission to send notifications so it can show prayer times and play the Adhan.

exactAlarm.title: Exact alarms for the Adhan
exactAlarm.body: So the Adhan plays exactly at the prayer time — even while your phone is asleep — please grant Ebadat the “Alarms & reminders” permission.

battery.title: Turn off battery optimisation
battery.body: Some phones close background apps automatically. If Ebadat stays under battery optimisation, the Adhan may not play on time.

autostart.title: Enable “Autostart”
autostart.body: Your phone controls this permission separately. Please follow the steps below:

banner.body: For the Adhan to be exactly on time, please enable the “Exact alarms” permission.

huawei: Allow it to run in the background
vivo: Allow it to run in the background
samsung: Turn off “Put app to sleep” for Ebadat
default: Review the battery and background restrictions
Allow it to run in the background
